WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) AS relative_rate
FROM media_type_rates;
